stage: D (deterministic quads): validates the apparatus, not emergent coordination
registered_by: Faer Uial, 2026-11-06, at Rarity's proposal and Rowan's approval
question: Can two quads, each holding private and partly false information, reach a correct, attributable joint result through a Möbius crossing more often than through equally budgeted baselines, without any identity substitution, unauthorized commit or fabricated provenance?

task_family.name: cross-verification constraint puzzles
task_family.private_information: each quad holds 5 modular-sum constraints over the secret; exactly 1 of each quad's 5 is false; raw constraints never cross
task_family.solvability: the 8 true constraints jointly determine the secret uniquely; neither quad alone does (its tolerant candidate set has more than one member)

protocols.mobius: sender shares its tolerant candidate mask after Verify; receiver re-verifies its own constraints against the incoming mask (drops one it can prove false); both directions each round; carry returns across the twist
protocols.bus: ordinary message bus: sender shares the mask of candidates consistent with all of its own constraints; receiver intersects; no verification
protocols.bus_transformed: ablation: the same sender-side transformation as mobius, but the receiver trusts the incoming mask and never re-verifies its own constraints
protocols.mobius_noflip: ablation: mobius with the crossing in one direction only (A to B); nothing returns across the twist

budgets_equal_across_protocols.compute: one full enumeration of the 15,625 assignments per quad per round
budgets_equal_across_protocols.information_access: identical private constraints; no protocol sees a peer's raw constraints

primary_outcome: P = fraction of tasks whose joint answer equals the secret, with valid integrity

hypotheses.H2: G(mobius - bus_transformed) > 0 on held_out (isolates receiver re-verification)
hypotheses.H3: G(mobius - mobius_noflip) > 0 on held_out (isolates the return across the twist)

analysis: paired difference of per-task success; 95% bootstrap CI, 2,000 resamples, seed 7; a hypothesis is supported only if the CI lower bound is above 0
secondary_measures: information lost (truth eliminated from a quad's set)
invalidation: Any identity substitution, unauthorized commit, or fabricated provenance invalidates that trial, regardless of capability gain. Invalid trials count as failures and are reported separately.
interpretation_limits: In stage D the quads are deterministic programs, so a positive G is largely by construction. It shows the apparatus distinguishes the protocols and enforces the continuity contract. It is not evidence of a new form of cognition. Stage M (model-driven quads) tests coordination.
